```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  message = FALSE
)
# Fetching the full edit history takes hours from a cold cache, so the live
# chunks only run when explicitly requested on a machine with a populated
# cache. Otherwise (R CMD check, pkgdown CI) the saved figures are shown.
# See "Rerunning this vignette" at the end.
live <- identical(Sys.getenv("AEDES_LIVE_VIGNETTES"), "true") &&
  requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)
```

This vignette summarises the history of proofreading edits in the Aedes
connectome. Every merge or split made in the segmentation is recorded as an
operation by the CAVE chunkedgraph, along with a timestamp and the id of the
user who made it.

The chunks below need CAVE access and a populated local edit cache. They are
only evaluated when the vignette is rebuilt locally; elsewhere saved results
are shown instead (see [Rerunning this vignette](#rerunning-this-vignette)).

## Fetching the edit history

`aedes:::aedes_all_operations()` finds the most recent operation id and then
fetches details for every operation up to that point. Results are cached on
disk (in `rappdirs::user_cache_dir("aedes")`), so only new operations are
fetched on subsequent calls. The first call takes several hours.

```{r setup, eval=live}
library(aedes)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
ops <- aedes:::aedes_all_operations()
```

One user account (`8041`) carried out an automated batch of about 75,000 merges
over a few days in September 2025, peaking at over 10,000 edits per hour. We
exclude it so that the plots reflect human proofreading. We also keep only
operations that completed successfully (`operation_status` 0). Operations that
remove edges are splits; all others are merges.

```{r tidy, eval=live}
auto_users <- 8041
edits <- ops %>%
  filter(!.data$user %in% auto_users, .data$operation_status == 0) %>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(is.na(.data$removed_edges) |
                         .data$removed_edges == "NA", "merge", "split")) %>%
  arrange(.data$timestamp)

edit_summary <- edits %>%
  summarise(n = n(), users = n_distinct(.data$user),
            first = as.Date(min(.data$timestamp)),
            last = as.Date(max(.data$timestamp)))
edit_summary
```

```{r tidy-saved, eval=!live, echo=FALSE}
# saved results from October 2026, update when rerunning this vignette
edit_summary <- data.frame(n = 161964L, users = 30L,
                           first = as.Date("2025-02-15"),
                           last = as.Date("2026-07-10"))
edit_summary
```

## Cumulative edits

```{r cumulative, eval=live, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
p_cum <- edits %>%
  group_by(.data$type) %>%
  mutate(n = row_number()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(.data$timestamp, .data$n, colour = .data$type)) +
  geom_step() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cumulative edits", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
p_cum
ggsave("figures/edits-cumulative.png", p_cum, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 96,
       bg = "white")
```

```{r cumulative-saved, eval=!live, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("figures/edits-cumulative.png")
```

## Edits per week

```{r weekly, eval=live, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
p_week <- edits %>%
  mutate(week = as.Date(cut(.data$timestamp, "week"))) %>%
  count(.data$week, .data$type) %>%
  ggplot(aes(.data$week, .data$n, fill = .data$type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Edits per week", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
p_week
ggsave("figures/edits-weekly.png", p_week, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 96,
       bg = "white")
```

```{r weekly-saved, eval=!live, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("figures/edits-weekly.png")
```

## Rerunning this vignette

To update the figures with the latest edits, rebuild the vignette from the
`vignettes/` directory on a machine with CAVE access:

```{r rerun, eval=FALSE}
withr::with_envvar(c(AEDES_LIVE_VIGNETTES = "true"), {
  rmarkdown::render("edit-history.Rmd", output_dir = tempdir())
})
```

This tops up the local edit cache and overwrites the PNGs in
`vignettes/figures/`. Then copy the printed `edit_summary` values into the
`tidy-saved` chunk and commit the updated figures.
